blocks.text: A Tampa CPA Explains the Benefits of Online Remarketing Campaigns for Small Businesses

If you have ever been browsing along on the Internet and noticed that a display ad for a website you visited recently popped up on an entirely different – and possibly unrelated – website, then you have witnessed online remarketing in action. It might seem a little off-putting, almost as if a segment of the Internet was following you around. But it is a great way for small businesses to reinforce an advertising message and generate online leads.

A [Tampa CPA](http://reliancecpa.com) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help small business owners develop ways to use the Internet and other strategies for building a customer base through advertising. Remarketing is a relatively affordable and effective way to make the most of a relatively small advertising budget, but it is only one method for small business owners to level the playing field online. Other methods of Internet marketing include:

• Pay per click

• Organic search engine optimization

• Social media marketing

• Facebook ads

• Twitter “promoted” tweets

• Static Internet display advertisements

• And more

To stay ahead of the competition, small businesses need to take advantage of every technological innovation available at a reasonable cost. And, compared to most traditional forms of advertising, Internet marketing is extremely affordable – and effective. [Contact](http://reliancecpa.com/contact.html) Reliance today to learn more about ways to gain greater market penetration through the use of the Internet.
